sheet_log.title: BUILDING ELEVATIONS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A2-01 shows Building Elevations South (Summit Hill Dr) and East (S Central St) for the Moxy Hotels project at 117 S Central St, Knoxville, TN. Scale is 1/4"=1'-0". Level elevations range from Level 01 Lower at 884'-10" through T/ Roof at 969'-0". Gypsum soffit quantity is not explicitly dimensioned or scheduled on this elevation sheet; the approximate 800 SF estimate is based on visible soffit conditions at the lower level open-to-beyond area and canopy conditions at both elevations using the stated scale. Actual soffit SF should be confirmed from floor plans or reflected ceiling plans. All keynote quantities (ea) are not enumerated on this sheet and would require a count from the drawings.

sheet_log.title: BUILDING ELEVATIONS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A2-02 shows two building elevations: (1) West elevation facing State St at scale 1/8"=1'-0" and (2) North elevation facing Access Easement at scale 1/8"=1'-0". Floor-to-floor heights range approximately 10'-6" to 11'-6" across 7 levels plus roof. Gypsum soffit quantities are not printed on this sheet; estimated values are based on visible canopy/soffit geometry scaled at 1/8"=1'-0" and are flagged approximate. The West elevation canopy soffit ~130 LF wide × ~8 ft deep ≈ 1,040 SF and North elevation canopy soffit ~110 LF × ~8 ft deep ≈ 880 SF. Exterior finish schedule lists four material tags (BK, CP-1, CP-2, CR). Twenty-three keynotes are referenced on the elevations covering lighting, plumbing, mechanical, electrical, structural, and signage elements. Color swatches shown for BK (Ashland), CP-1 (Steel), CP-2 (Opal), and CR (Center) finishes.

sheet_log.title: BUILDING ELEVATIONS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A2-03 shows four building elevations (East-Drive Court, North-Drive Court, South-Driveway, South-Drive Court) at 1/8"=1'-0" scale for a 6-story hotel (Moxy Hotels brand) in Knoxville, TN. Floor levels range from Level 01 Lower at ~894'-10" to T/Roof at 960'-2", total building height approximately 65'-4".
